mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP2D6, the primary enzyme metabolizing metoprolol, leading to increased metoprolol plasma concentrations and enhanced beta-blockade effects.
action: Monitor heart rate and blood pressure closely; consider reducing metoprolol dose or selecting an alternative beta-blocker metabolized by other pathways; assess for signs of excessive beta-blockade (bradycardia, hypotension, fatigue).
